subject: general
question: In which city was the 4th International Race Walking Championships held in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranchi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **ninth edition** of the National Open Race Walking Championships, a qualifying event for the 2022 year’s World Championships, was held in** Ranchi, Jharkhand.**
 
• The championships will have 35km and 20km race walk events for men and 20km events for women.
 
• There will also be 10km events for both U-
10 men and women.
 
• The championships will also be a qualifying event for the World Championships to be held in Eugene, USA, from July 15-24.
